preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 300000.
The number of plans q must be between 1 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each mineral resource a_i must be between 1 and n.
The number of edges must be exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan must have valid city indices and resource bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(c_i for c_i in valid_resources) else str(c_i)
postconditions.description: If no valid mineral resource c_i exists, output -1; otherwise, output any valid c_i.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i in range(l_i, r_i + 1) for c_i, l_i, r_i in zip(valid_resources, l_values, r_values))
postconditions.description: Each valid mineral resource c_i must be within the specified bounds l_i and r_i.
Each valid mineral resource c_i must appear an odd number of times between the specified cities.
